quotes.text: Most users never think about the back end. But it's what makes everything work. And it's part of the broader Microsoft ecosystem. Teams, Outlook, Power Platform, Co-Pilot, they're all connected.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why the hidden back end and ecosystem integration matter more than the agent UI.

quotes.text: A case is a single customer issue. It's the central record that everything revolves around. Every email, every phone call, every chat message, it all links back to one case record.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp definition of the case as the single source of truth in customer service.

quotes.text: These agents don't work in isolation. The intent agent finds a new pattern. The knowledge management agent drafts an article about it. The case management agent starts using that article to resolve similar issues automatically.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Shows how the specialised AI agents reinforce each other into a learning system.

quotes.text: The knowledge base behind that portal is the same one your agents use internally. One source of truth. When an agent updates a knowledge article on their end, the portal reflects that change immediately.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Makes the case for a single knowledge base shared by self-service and agents.

chapters.title: Case management, the heart of the system

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Customer Service ties every email, chat, call and social interaction to a single case record built on Dataverse, so customers no longer repeat themselves.
Omnichannel routing, Copilot summaries and dedicated AI agents for case management, intent, knowledge and quality take routine work off service reps.
Deep Teams and Outlook integration, Power Pages self-service portals and real-time analytics turn support into one connected, measurable operation.
hook: Support teams lose time and customer trust when email, phone, chat and CRM live in separate tools. This Simply Explained episode is for service leaders and Microsoft 365 admins who want to understand how Dynamics 365 Customer Service connects cases, channels, Copilot and AI agents, Teams and Outlook, self-service and analytics in one platform.
